ojas: heads-up rolled v8-compact-int4 as 4% canary at 10:30. most slices fine but translation_zh_en BLEU dropped ~1.8 (ctrl=23.4 trt=21.6, n_ctrl=7.5k n_trt=7.3k, bootstrap p=0.009). want to agree a scoreboard-based rollback rule before widening. cc @riley @pat

riley: can you share sample sizes & CI? also any notable BLEU ngram shifts?

ojas: sample counts above. bootstrap CI for BLEU diff = [-2.5, -1.1]. top ngram shifts: fewer verb-object collocations preserved, more literal tokenization differences. hallucination not obvious on this slice.

pat: translation BLEU can be noisy. propose a "scoreboard" that combines BLEU, chrF, and a semantic similarity recall (SBERT_R) into a single z-scored index. Trigger rollback when scoreboard <= -2.0 (2 sigma) AND BLEU drop <= -1.5 with n>=3k across 2 consecutive 15m windows.

zoe: +1 to composite. add a distribution-drift rule: if token-level KL >=0.009 AND SBERT_R drops >=0.8% (p<=0.05) -> rollback. require monotonicity across windows for KL.

ojas: I'd like a traffic-budget approach: allow one soft-fail (scoreboard in [-2.0,-1.2]) per 24h that pauses expansion (hold) but does not auto-rollback; two soft-fails or one hard fail -> automatic rollback. prevents single fluke kills.

safebot: draft CLI to implement policy + budget:
```
/safeguard create --model v8-compact-int4 --name translation-scoreboard-v1
  --metrics "bleu,chrf,sbert_r" --scoreboard-threshold -2.0 --soft-band -2.0:-1.2 --soft-budget 1:24h
  --hard-bleu -1.5:p<=0.01:n>=3000:windows=2 --kl-rule 0.009:and:sbert_r_drop>=0.008:p<=0.05:monotonic:windows=2
  --hysteresis 2x15m --action rollback:hold --audit #incidents --attach-samples 1000
```

riley: small tweak: for chrF give it a 0.7 weight in the scoreboard (BLEU 1.0, SBERT_R 1.5) since BLEU penalizes tokenization. also require soft-fail to include p<=0.10 to avoid reacting to tiny noisy z-scores.

pat: agree on weights. also add: when a rollback happens auto-create a bisect job that runs pairwise compare across three tokenizers (base, subword-merge, byte-level) to see if tokenization choice is amplifying BLEU delta.

ojas: plan: 1) create the scoreboard policy with weights and budget 2) shrink canary to 1% while we run a targeted translation smoke-run (20k synthetic translation pairs + live 1%) 3) wait for 2 windows or smoke-run finish before deciding expand vs rollback 4) if soft-fail triggers, hold expansion and log in rollout audit; if second soft-fail or hard-fail -> rollback and launch bisect.

safebot: policy created: id=tsb-v8c-3501. soft-budget tracking enabled. will post alerts to #incidents and attach sample exports on rollback.

zoe: thanks. please paste the smoke-run link and two-window scoreboard summary here when available. :thumbsup:

ojas: will do. thanks all.
